title: Leads instead of Contacts; Learn becomes Help
recommendation: Replace Contacts in the nav with Leads (every form submission, newest first, with the page it came from and when), keep the old contact list read-only behind an "Older contacts" link with export, and move Learn to a "Help" item in the account menu.
